issues.description: Wrong page shown: URL is /dashboard but test expects the marketing landing page at / (root). The browser navigated to /dashboard instead of the landing page.
issues.root_cause: The test is running against http://localhost:3000/dashboard instead of http://localhost:3000/. The landing page lives at apps/web/app/page.tsx (root route), but the current URL is /dashboard. This is a navigation/routing issue - the app may be auto-redirecting authenticated users to /dashboard.

issues.description: Hydration error on apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx: Text content mismatch between server and client. Server renders 'Which room are we designing?' but client renders 'Style Quiz'. This causes full root re-render to client rendering.
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx, a heading or title element conditionally renders different text on server vs client - likely using state initialized differently, or reading from localStorage/sessionStorage which doesn't exist on server, causing the text to differ between SSR and hydration.

issues.description: Multiple repeated hydration errors across several pages (step-3, step-3b, step-7c, step-8a, dashboard). Server-rendered HTML does not match client content.
issues.root_cause: Pages in apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx and similar are using browser-only APIs (localStorage, window, Math.random, Date) during render without suppressing hydration or using useEffect, causing SSR/client mismatch.

fixes.reason: Adding 'use client' directive prevents SSR of this component entirely, eliminating the hydration mismatch between server-rendered 'Which room are we designing?' and client-rendered 'Style Quiz'. This is the most targeted fix for the hydration error without rewriting the component.
